message:
Hey all! Ash here - Just a quick re-upload of my Refined Character Creator, for posterity and exposure: https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Refined_Character_Creator~42d0ae649b939cfa0f13c69214cf3622.gz

Makes a character from as little or as much info as you provide, and has a format that is easy to read and edit. 

And my Character Visualizer, for generating character descriptions for image generators (works the same as the RCC - just give it a name and/or some details, and let it do the rest!): https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Character_Visualizer~8450c29e01e5fed854b2c4f6a1563a1d.gz

It also generates a test image using the exact same prompt, so you can preview it! 

And the link to the shared character gallery, where you can find these and many more bots made buy the community!: perchance.org/shared-characters-from-ai-character-chat-comments
